trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops. The official text says shops, so read it literally and buy from shop stock rather than counting property or mission costs; spread the spending and let the dollar counter fill.
trophies.where: Shops across Leonida. No shop list is given.
trophies.when: Free roam, once you have the money.
